name: Honda NS400R
engine: 387 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke V3, three carbs, oil injection
intro: Honda's three-cylinder two-stroke road bike based on its GP machines. Parts are getting hard to find.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
